content.short: Higlobe gives freelancers USD and EUR receiving accounts, local payouts and a card backed by USDC balances.
content.description: Higlobe is a cross-border payments service that helps freelancers, contractors and small businesses in markets like the Philippines, India, Brazil, Mexico and Colombia receive money from US, UK and EU clients. Users get a free USD or EUR receiving account, collect payments from employers and platforms, and withdraw to their local bank at competitive rates with near-instant transfers and no percentage fee. Higlobe also offers a virtual card backed by the customer's USDC balance, extending the product beyond simple receiving accounts into stablecoin-linked spending. Registered as a money service business with FinCEN, Higlobe focuses on helping professionals who earn in dollars keep more of each payment and use those funds more flexibly.
